summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and added rich.align.VerticalCenter. Changes: rich/tree.py (Tree.__rich_measure__, iterative DFS with explicit stack, four cells per indent level); rich/align.py (Align.__repr__, width constraint to measured maximum in rendering path, new VerticalCenter class with render, measurement, repr); rich/console.py (print renders collected renderables with justify="default", still passing justify into _collect_renderables); CHANGELOG.md (9.8.0 marked Unreleased, Added subsection with two entries); tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py (new imports and tests for repr, rendering, measurement, and the Tree acceptance example). Nothing was run: tests, scripts, and installs were off-limits per instructions, so all verification is by reading the code. No commits made.
